description: Fetch a same-origin HTML fragment, sanitize it, and insert it into the page

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of the HTML fragment, resolved against the page (document.baseURI). Only same-origin http(s) URLs load; blob:, data:, javascript: and other schemes are always refused; other origins need allow-cross-origin. A same-origin URL that redirects off-origin is refused. Observed: changing it re-fetches (honouring lazy); a change made while detached loads on reconnect.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: How fetched content is inserted. append/prepend leave existing children (including author scripts) untouched. Unknown values behave as replace and log a warning.

attributes.name: lazy
attributes.description: Defer loading until the element is within 200px of the viewport (also for later src changes)

attributes.name: trusted
attributes.description: Author vouches for the source: insert the fetched HTML without sanitizing. Without it the fragment goes through VB's sanitizer (no scripts, on* handlers, javascript: URLs, iframes, forms…). Never set it for URLs that serve user-generated content.

attributes.name: allow-scripts
attributes.description: Run the fragment's scripts (each once per load). Requires trusted; ignored with a console warning otherwise.

attributes.name: allow-cross-origin
attributes.description: Permit fetching from another origin (the server must allow it via CORS). Content is still sanitized unless trusted is also set.

attributes.name: data-label-error
attributes.description: Text of the role="alert" error message shown when a load fails and no fallback content remains

attributes.name: data-loading
attributes.description: Present while content is loading (aria-busy="true" is set alongside)

attributes.name: data-error
attributes.description: Present if the fetch fails or the URL is refused (origin, scheme, include cycle, nesting deeper than 10)

properties.name: src
properties.description: Mirror of the src attribute. Setting it updates the attribute (which loads the new URL) and fires include-file:src-changed.

methods.name: reload()
methods.description: Re-fetch the current src (same policy checks as a normal load).

events.name: include-file:loaded
events.description: After the fragment is inserted. src is the attribute value, url the resolved absolute URL, html the markup as inserted (sanitized unless trusted).

events.name: include-file:error
events.description: When the fetch fails or the load is refused; error is a message string. The original fallback is restored on a first-load failure in replace mode.

events.name: include-file:src-changed
events.description: After .src is assigned a new value from script (not for direct attribute changes)
